concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-subscription-update-node]] - Node.js updates to an existing subscription, including add-on and discount add-update-remove scope, conditional 3DS-enriched nonce guidance for the next transaction, and the option that removes all existing add-ons and discounts
warnings: Keep the source scoped to updating an existing subscription; do not import subscription-creation prerequisites or behavior.

Preserve the conditional wording for 3DS: the enriched nonce is required when the merchant uses 3D Secure and needs to apply 3DS to the next transaction of an existing subscription, not for every update.
Preserve the one-addition qualification and the destructive remove-all scope without inferring proration, immediate charging, update timing, or other billing effects.
Use the exact raw locator for field and override inventories rather than copying routine request detail into the concept.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-subscription-update-node]] - Braintree Node.js route for existing-subscription updates, add-on and discount changes, qualified 3DS-enriched nonce use for the next transaction, and removal of all existing add-ons and discounts
warnings: Treat this as a retrieval route for Braintree's update operation, not as a generic recurring-payments rule or complete subscription lifecycle specification.
Do not generalize the page's Node.js examples or its conditional 3DS guidance to other Braintree SDKs, payment methods, or all subscription updates.
Do not infer creation behavior, billing timing, proration, immediate charging, or payment-method eligibility from this update reference.
